title: Home Insurance Premium Premium Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeinsurance:premium premium_usd=*
| stats sum(premium_usd) as total_value, avg(premium_usd) as avg_value by carrier_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks carrier values by total and average premium amount across home insurance premium events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `premium_usd` values for each home insurance premium event and review total and average premium amount by carrier.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total premium amount.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which carrier shows the biggest premium amount numbers in your home insurance premium data.
